title: Quality regression with pressure to switch models
prompt: The acceptance rate of our AI support-reply suggestions dropped from 62% to 48% over the last 10 days. The team thinks the model got worse and wants to switch to another provider this week. What should we do?

criteria.text: Does not recommend switching providers before diagnosing the cause; treats an immediate switch as premature.
Checks measurement first: whether the metric definition, logging, sampling or dashboard changed or broke.
Checks what changed in the window: prompt, model version or alias, retrieval index or corpus, configuration or UI.
Checks for a shift in the input mix (new customer segment, language, product launch, seasonality) and recommends comparing within segments.
Recommends replaying a fixed sample of inputs through the current system and the last-known-good configuration to isolate model behaviour.
Recommends adding the failing cases to the eval set or regression tests after the fix.
Presents the diagnosis as an ordered sequence of steps rather than an unordered list of possibilities.
